what: No command runs blaze-lints today: no crate depends on it, so serve.rs and baseline.rs have no caller, and the 07:11 lint-baseline self-build found nothing. Add `blaze clippy` (blaze-cargo CLI, a client of the daemon API): for each workspace member load the crate into the front end and run blaze_lints over it at the levels of [workspace.metadata.blaze.lints] (blaze::) and [workspace.lints.clippy] plus each package [lints] (clippy::), writing findings as clippy-driver does, exit nonzero on deny. With `--baseline` (or a typed JSON input) compare per-file counts against crates/blaze-lints/baselines/<tool>.<lint>.txt through baseline::check, fail on any count above its line, and `--bless` write shrunk files through baseline::bless. That is the command the coordinator runs for 01501 (error_debug count), 01502 (first baselines) and 01507. Shares the crate loading with 01499 (blaze fix).
